git.bad_branch: This branch name is not allowed.
git.state_unknown: Could not read the state of the repository.
git.state_no_remote: The repository has no server (origin): its commits stay on this computer.
git.state_not_on_server: Branch “{}” is not on the server yet. “Send to server” creates it there.
git.state_synced: Everything matches the server (as of the last check).
git.hint_sync: “Get changes” downloads new commits from the server. “Send to server” uploads your commits. “Check the server” only finds out what is new.
git.hint_conflict: The repository has a merge conflict. Resolve it in a Git client.
git.err.identity: Git does not know your name and e-mail for commits. Set them in a Git client or with git config --global user.name and user.email.
git.err.credentials: Git could not sign in to the server. Sign in with gh auth login or glab auth login, set up an SSH key, or a credential manager.
git.err.network: No connection to the Git server. Check the internet connection.
git.err.diverged: The server and this computer both have new commits. Merge them in a Git client, then send again.
git.err.rejected: The server refused the commits: it has newer ones. Get the changes first, then send again.
git.err.local_changes: Local changes would be overwritten. Commit them (or stash them in a Git client) first.
git.err.no_upstream: This branch is not connected to a branch on the server yet.
git.err.no_remote: The repository has no server to send to (origin).
git.pick_branch: Which branch should be merged into “{}”?
git.confirm_merge_branch: Merge branch “{}” into “{}”? If files conflict, you can resolve them here or cancel the merge.
git.confirm_merge_remote: Join your commits with the server's new ones? A merge commit is made; if files conflict, you can resolve them here or cancel the merge.
git.state_diverged: Commits to send: {} · new on the server: {}. Press “Merge with server”.
git.hint_commit_first: Before merging, commit or discard the current changes.
git.merge_ready: All conflicts are resolved. Finish the merge.
git.merge_hint: Pick a file and resolve it: keep your version, take theirs, or fix the file and mark it resolved. Scenes and prefabs can be tried with Unity smart merge.
git.confirm_abort: Cancel the merge and return everything to how it was before? Choices made for conflicts will be lost.
git.confirm_markers: “{}” still has conflict markers (<<<<<<<). Mark it resolved anyway?
git.smart_done: Unity smart merge resolved {} of {} files.
git.smart_failed: UnityYAMLMerge could not merge this file: the same properties were changed differently. Choose a version or fix the file by hand.
git.smart_no_tool: Smart merge needs an installed Unity Editor (it carries UnityYAMLMerge).
git.operation_elsewhere: The repository has an unfinished “{}” started in another program. Finish or cancel it there.
